description: Main backend source code for the CodeReview Assistant system, built with FastAPI. It handles user registration, authentication, repository upload, analysis processing (including git diff, ripgrep scans, and LLM calls), and provides endpoints for retrieving analysis results and history.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Schema for user registration data containing username, email, and password.

classes.name: UserRead
classes.description: Schema for returning user info, including ID, username, email, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: SessionRead
classes.description: Schema representing user session tokens, including token string, user ID, creation and expiration timestamps.

classes.name: RepoUploadInput
classes.description: Schema for repo upload input, mainly the repo path.

classes.name: AnalysisResultRead
classes.description: Schema for returning analysis results, including IDs, timestamps, commit message, suggestions, issues, and raw LLM response.

classes.name: GenericResponse
classes.description: Generic schema for API responses with a message detail.

methods.name: register(user: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user, storing hashed password.

methods.name: login(form: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate user and create a session token.

methods.name: get_user_by_token(token: str, db: Session)
methods.description: Utility to retrieve user session info based on token.

methods.name: get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Dependency to fetch authenticated user from token.

methods.name: str save_upload_file_tmp(upload_file: UploadFile)
methods.description: Stores uploaded zip file temporarily and returns its path.

methods.name: upload_repo( file: UploadFile = File(...), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models_module.User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint to upload and extract a repo zip, register in database.

methods.name: cleanup(*paths)
methods.description: Removes temporary files or directories.

methods.name: analyze_repo( upload_id: int = Form(..., description="Upload ID returned from /repo/upload"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models_module.User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Runs git diff, ripgrep, and calls LLM tools for analysis, saving results.

methods.name: analyze_api(request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models_module.User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Frontend compatible API to analyze a repo directory path and return a summary.

methods.name: str try_git_diff(path: str)
methods.description: Attempts to get git diff from repository; initializes git if not present.

methods.name: str try_ripgrep(path: str)
methods.description: Runs ripgrep to scan the repo directory.

methods.name: call_llm_tools(git_diff: str, rg_results: str, repo_path: str)
methods.description: Placeholder function mimicking LLM calls for commit message and suggestions.

methods.name: get_analysis(upload_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models_module.User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Fetches all analysis results for a specific upload ID.

methods.name: get_history(db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models_module.User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves full analysis history for the logged-in user.

methods.name: health_check()
